content.stem: 一家大型银行的反洗钱合规官收到一份关于私人银行部门的内部审计报告。报告指出，员工未遵循基于风险的尽职调查程序，导致该部门未能有效运行。反洗钱合规官应考虑采取哪些紧急措施来处理这些发现？(选择两项。)

options.A: 私人银行家应接受反洗钱程序培训
options.B: 管理层应在私人银行部门实施质量保证计划
options.C: 董事会应审查并批准一项修订后的反洗钱政策，以改变私人银行的客户尽职调查要求
options.D: 法务部门应进行审查，以评估潜在的法律后果
options.E: 所有员工都应接受反洗钱复训

content.stem_en: An AML compliance officer for a large bank has recently received an internal audit report on the private banking unit. The report revealed that the unit staff were not following risk-based due diligence procedures, so the unit was not operating effectively. Which immediate actions should the AML compliance officer consider to address these findings? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Private bankers should receive training on AML procedures
options_en.B: Management should implement a quality assurance program in the private banking unit
options_en.C: The board should review and approve a revised AML policy to change the private banking customer due diligence requirements
options_en.D: The legal department should conduct a review to assess potential legal consequences
options_en.E: All employees should receive refresher AML training
